written: Third untouched real-request set. Candidates collected 2026-10-15 from the Stack Exchange API with the fixed query plans in scripts/phase250-collect-requests.mjs (PLAN250 and PLAN250B), after the Phase250 freeze (e8d0574); selected by an explicit criterion (asks which product or type to buy, or what to look for when buying; excluding where-to-buy, consumables, books and usage problems; two cases without a licence field dropped). Gold written by the assistant from the excerpts only, before any arm was run on these texts. Labels use evaluation/phase250/need-catalogue.json. T2: not author-independent, not independently adjudicated.
attribution: Each text is an excerpt of a Stack Exchange post by the named author, licensed under the CC BY-SA version stated per case; the excerpts in this file are shared under the same licences.
scoring: Needs are scored for catalogue categories; for other:<name> cases only false needs count. Budget: an expected budget must be found; a budget found where none is expected is an error.
